notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Sheet 'c' is the white edge and 'd' the edge + border (read as AS 1743 does: 10/30 = edge 10 + border 20, 5/15 = 5 + 10, 15/45 = 15 + 30), confirmed against the national R-series pairs. TC-series sheet TC1210_3 'Road train route' special warning sign, page 3 of 4 (2008; pages 1/3 are the 'Smaller vehicles use shoulder' legends for road trains / B-doubles, pages 2/4 the 'Beware when overtaking' legends). Size A generated (B 2100 x 2660 also tabled): r 175, c 16 / d 32 (edge 16 + border 16). Two panels on one outline: top yellow with black border and legend, bottom red with white border and legend, meeting at y 1135 with no divider (the red panel is drawn as three paths with the bottom corners R175 / 159 / 143 over the yellow panel's outline, as the sheet draws it). Right chain p 105 / f 100DM / o 100 / m 750 / k 80 / j 70 / h 100DN / g 65 / f 100DM / g 65 / f / g 65 / f / e 100 = 1900 (b): title cap top 105, symbol y 305, split 1135, red-panel cap tops 1205, 1370, 1535, 1700. Symbol box n 1270 wide centred (x 115) x m 750. 'DN' (the sheet's 'AS1744 Series D Narrow', title and first red line) and 'DM' ('Series D Medium') are both read as plain Series D. Word gaps measured on the sheet: SMALLER-VEHICLES 83.8, USE-SHOULDER 89.5, WHEN-OVERTAKING 97.0, OR-APPROACHING 90.1, B-DOUBLE-ROUTE 82.5. Symbol extracted from the sheet PDF's own filled vector paths (tools/symbols/qld_tc1210_truck_car_hill.svg, drawn n x m exactly). Black on retroreflective yellow, white on retroreflective red.
